mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_media_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at, created_at) ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT
FROM sys_media_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{timeoutSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second') ORDER BY updated_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_media_task SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_node = #{workerNode}, claim_version = claim_version + 1, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE sys_media_task SET status = 'PENDING', worker_node = NULL, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, error_log = #{errorLog}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND worker_node = #{workerNode} AND claim_version = #{claimVersion}
